structured.feedback: The description is about 190 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews (metal tines, less tugging, easy to clean, three-pack, satisfaction guarantee), and it leaves out the "too big" complaint, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split and the thin "Simple to Clean" section.
